ZUG, Switzerland, July 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lithium Argentina AG (“ **Lithium Argentina** ” or the “ **Company** ”) ( **TSX: LAR** ) ( **NYSE: LAR** ) will release its second quarter 2026 earnings results before market open on Tuesday, August 11, 2026.


The Company will hold a webcast and conference call to discuss its second quarter 2026 results on Tuesday, August 11, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET. The webcast will be accessible on the Investor Relations section of the Company website at[https://investors.lithium-argentina.com/news-events/events.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=gXIa5qbjbn0ZjWCcsENVN_j3PpiZC1AqLoBKnqxCp_k3UeUK7GVWZHla2cOKML27QLJYuIRmZTsYenL2fr9UoDyB7NtX6NzAaPUXwGjyFwwgX13zf6ORVCKqazrhBFxCuJpWjok2ISwTrnLN0qfuCILKxK1IEBDQy9FoYHE85s2kMLDDs5rTvFmPmFqUOTjrGvZsvusn_TBTBIfsKhPJWA==)


**Webcast Details:**
Event Title: Lithium Argentina Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call
Event Date: August 11, 2026
Start Time: 10:00 AM Eastern time (US and Canada)


**Attendee URL:**[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/399739791](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=gXIa5qbjbn0ZjWCcsENVN1U7r7hPbsfliHg0LY12rB_b4orrF1fKM3nVWcTl0WPpNVpNbYOGnYX_0KXMlQm2YBZKAU8TC2J0HRrHjp1y1fv-8AqNY3X0JJDyVuNfx6Q_cAtcAqeGmV1RUqaDGjx8n6PpI9xAYtfMwhk7ro6WWVo=)

**ABOUT LITHIUM ARGENTINA**


Lithium Argentina, in partnership with Ganfeng, operates the Cauchari-Olaroz lithium brine operation in Argentina and is advancing additional lithium resources in the region. Lithium Argentina currently trades on the TSX and on the NYSE.
